item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The scope of work under Contract OH-88 at the Owls Head Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility includes the replacement of the sixteen final settling tank (FST) sludge collection system mechanisms, replacement of the aeration diffuser system within the four aeration tanks (AT), replacement of the four aeration blowers, ancillary process air system improvements, rehabilitation of the FST and AT interior structures, and improvements to related FST systems, such as Return Activated Sludge Pumps, scum pumps, FST Gallery sump pumps, spray water pumps, and polymer feed systems.
